question: Two trains, 297 m and 243 m, in length are running in opposite directions. The first runs at the rate of 42 km/hr and the second at the rate of 66 km/hr. How long will they take to cross each other?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add

Total speed = 42 + 66 = 108 km/hr = 30 m/s

Total distance = 297 + 243 = 540 m

Time = 540 ÷ 30 = 18 sec

**∴ Answer = 18 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lengths = 297 m and 243 m

Speeds = 42 km/hr and 66 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 297 + 243 = 540 m

⇒ Relative speed = 42 + 66 = 108 km/hr

⇒ Convert ⇒ 108 × 5/18 = 30 m/s

⇒ Time = 540 ÷ 30 = 18 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 18 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add.

Train Rule

Total distance = sum of train lengths.

Conversion

km/hr to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18.
